name: json_tool
description: Validate, pretty-print, or minify JSON (AssemblyScript). WHEN TO USE: a tool result, config file, or pasted blob is JSON you need reformatted or checked for validity — a parse error reports the exact line and column instead of just "invalid". Input: {"json": "...", "mode": "validate"|"pretty"|"minify"} (mode defaults to "pretty"); the JSON text may also be passed bare, unwrapped.
llm_description: Validate, pretty-print, or minify JSON; parse errors report exact line/column. {"json":"...","mode":"validate"|"pretty"|"minify"} (mode defaults pretty); json may be passed bare, unwrapped.

json.description: The JSON text to validate or reformat.

mode.description: validate, pretty, or minify. Defaults to pretty.
